title: Spike Items
description: Adds item textures for Pointed Dripstone and Sulfur Spikes!
body:
Items for **Pointed Dripstone** and **Sulfur Spikes** use textures from their placed blocks, which makes sense but isn't very interesting and feels inconsistent compared to other items that are crafted into blocks (e.g. Quartz, Prismarine, Clay, etc). This pack adds **new item textures** for these two items! I find that this pack is nice to use with my [**Sulfur to Gunpowder**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/sulfur-to-gunpowder) and [**Sulfur Oxidation**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/sulfur-oxidation) data packs, as they use Sulfur Spikes in recipes. ## ### MintRefresh:
